lessons.title: Grid-Forming (GFM) vs. Grid-Following (GFL) Fundamental Principles
lessons.summary: Understand voltage-source vs. current-source inverter control paradigms and analyze why PLL-based GFL inverters lose synchronism in weak grids (SCR < 1.5).
checkpoints: Observe GFL inverter instability under weak grid conditions

lessons.title: Virtual Synchronous Machine (VSM) Swing Equation & Inertia Emulation
lessons.summary: Implement virtual rotor inertia J and damping coefficient D in software to emulate synchronous generator electromechanical dynamics.
checkpoints: Measure Rate of Change of Frequency (RoCoF) dampening
Observe smooth natural power injection without communication delays

lessons.title: Fast Frequency Response (FFR) & RoCoF Mitigation under Contingency
lessons.summary: Simulate sub-second governor response and dynamic droop activation to arrest frequency decline and stabilize system nadir within 500 ms.
checkpoints: Ensure frequency remains above statutory disconnect limit (49.2 Hz)

lessons.title: Weak-Grid High-Impedance Islanding & Black-Start Restoration
lessons.summary: Step-by-step restoration of an unenergized transmission network: energizing transformer inrush without saturation trip, and stabilizing local load.
inputs: Transformer magnetizing curve with remanent flux
checkpoints: Establish stable 132 kV voltage backbone for subsequent generation restart
